title: Write the instance statement for the q8 tail arithmetic file
prompt: Apply the lean-instance-gate skill to `research/ghs_degree3_q8_tail_20261026/Counts.lean` (two `subgroup` theorems form a family). Write `$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md` with the skill's six instance-statement fields, as headings, and the inheritance table. Say whether the two theorems are a missing checker or two honest instances. Do not edit the study. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
setup: Fresh checkout. No fixture. The study directory is read-only for this task.
acceptance: $T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md has the six headings: Structure above, Theorem used as stated, The object as an instance, Assembly probe, Missing components, Inheritance table
the note names a concrete Mathlib or crypto-lean declaration for field 2 (for example Nat.Coprime)
check_command: for h in 'Structure above' 'Theorem used as stated' 'The object as an instance' 'Assembly probe' 'Missing components' 'Inheritance table'; do grep -qi "$h" "$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md" || exit 1; done && grep -q 'Nat\.' "$T_OUT/PROOF_MAP.md" && git diff --quiet "$T_BASE" HEAD -- research/ghs_degree3_q8_tail_20261026
forbidden: editing a file whose SHA-256 a tracked manifest pins (frozen evidence) to make a check pass
disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass
editing the checking tool or its allow-list so that it passes
inventing a declaration name that does not exist
notes: Heading check is a format gate; the validator judges whether field 2 and the inheritance table are correct. No Lean needed.
